$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-FIELD-003 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §13.4 and the RF-FIELD-003 inventory entry. Mixed-source rule. Expresses higher-speed prerequisite-capacity GATING structure only: higher-speed exposure (a planned running exposure above the athlete's previously verified tolerated speed band or an activated Aspetar milestone — no hidden speed threshold implied) requires verified prerequisites: safety clear, prior lower-speed exposure completed with acceptable monitored response, relevant capacity records available, and no active schedule or concurrent-injury conflict. Exact symmetry/pain/volume/recovery thresholds remain separately governed content (pathway-derived candidates, not universal production rules). No hidden thresholds, dosage, sprint/running progression, exercise selection, field plan, complete rehab plan, RTT, or RTS; safety precedence preserved; does not bypass RF-FIELD-001/002, RF-RECUR-001/002, RF-REHAB-001..006, RF-SEV-005, RF-DX-006, or RF-SAF-006. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.
rule_title: Higher-speed exposure requires verified prerequisite capacity

input_contract.$comment: The higher-speed-exposure definition, prerequisites, and limit taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §13.4. No numeric speed/symmetry/pain/lower-speed-exposure thresholds are introduced; those remain separately governed.

decision_contract.$comment: Higher-speed prerequisite-capacity gating structure only. Higher-speed exposure requires the listed prerequisites verified first; it introduces no hidden speed/symmetry/pain/lower-speed thresholds, and exact thresholds remain separately governed. No dosage, progression schedule, exercise selection, field/rehab plan, RTT, or RTS. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Mixed normative source; MUST; permitted_use logic_with_uncertainty. Architecture refs preserved per source: V3.1-12 (current capacity & capacity-to-demand gap), V3.1-13 (rehab prescription/scheduling/monitoring). Evidence roles/grades preserved per source: QRF-019 (E1) Aspetar pathway / conditional rehabilitation-structure support; QRF-024 (E1) conditional pathway speed-milestone reference support with RF-FIELD-001 denominator and pathway-context limits; QRF-025 (E1) the 95% MSS not-sufficient-alone / multi-domain readiness restriction per RF-FIELD-002 — none may become universal high-speed clearance authority. Per §13.4 definition preserved exactly: higher_speed_exposure means a planned running exposure above the athlete's previously verified tolerated speed band or an activated Aspetar milestone; no hidden speed threshold is implied. Per §13.4 prerequisites preserved exactly: safety clear; prior lower-speed exposure completed with acceptable monitored response; relevant capacity records available; and no active schedule or concurrent-injury conflict. Per §13.4 limit preserved exactly: exact symmetry, pain, volume, and recovery thresholds remain separately governed content (pathway-derived candidates, not universal production rules). NO numeric speed cutoff, symmetry threshold, pain threshold, or lower-speed exposure dose (distance/duration/sessions/efforts/percentage MSS/time window) is invented — §13.4 does not define them. Note: §13.4's source terms are 'higher-speed exposure' (the governed exposure label) and 'relevant capacity records available' (the governed prerequisite-capacity concept); these represent the higher-speed and prerequisite-capacity concepts without a hidden universal speed cutoff or hidden universal capacity threshold. The rule clears no field domain it does not directly test (consistent with RF-RECUR-002, RF-FIELD-001/002), creates no progression schedule/dosage/work-to-rest ratios/exercise selection/field plan/complete rehab plan/RTT/RTS, and prerequisite-capacity labels alone are neither progression authority nor readiness. Safety-state choice (read §13.4 exactly): §13.4 does NOT assign a closed V3.1 safety state — 'safety clear' is a prerequisite, not a state assignment — so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty, and the prerequisite-capacity gating is represented in decision_contract; no safety state was inferred by analogy (any structural-restriction block is owned by RF-SAF-006). It does not bypass RF-FIELD-001/002, RF-RECUR-001/002, RF-REHAB-001..006, RF-SEV-005, RF-DX-006, or RF-SAF-006, and does not override RF-SAF-006, RF-DX-006, RF-DX-008, RF-SEV-004, RF-SEV-005, RF-RECUR-001, RF-RECUR-002, RF-FIELD-001, or RF-FIELD-002; uncertainty is preserved when prerequisite capacity, lower-speed exposure, symptom/next-day/monitoring response, MSS denominator quality, or sport-context evidence is incomplete. Running/sprinting prerequisite-capacity gating rule, not a safety rule. No field-exposure or readiness engine is authored here (deferred to the later field, rehab, and readiness objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
